entities.summary: Gamelan selunding is a sacred ensemble of gamelan music from Bali, Indonesia. The selunding ensemble is from Tenganan, a village in east Bali; the ensemble is rare. Selunding means "great" or "large". Selonding is also a musical instrument made of iron.
